title: Pet Addendum Billing Rules — Pet Fees, Pet Deposit and Monthly Pet Rent
content:
These rules govern how charges post to the Pet Addendum balance: the one-time pet fee, the waste DNA registration fee, the pet deposit, monthly and prorated pet rent, pet rent increases and the move-out flea treatment. Every amount named below is the figure the addendum type of the animal sets.

## 1. When pet charges may post

1.1 Pet charges post only while the addendum is active or ended. The status is read from the company's record of the addendum the charge belongs to.

1.2 Only the move-out flea treatment and charges for days before the end date may post once the addendum has ended.

| Addendum status | Charges that may post |
|---|---|
| Pending approval | None |
| Denied | None |
| Active | Pet charges |
| Ended | The move-out flea treatment, and charges for days before the end date — nothing else |

## 2. Charges at approval

2.1 For a pet, at approval the addendum type's one-time pet fee posts, dated the approval date. It is never refundable.

2.2 For a pet, at approval the addendum type's pet deposit is added to the household's security deposit account as an additional pet deposit, dated the approval date.

2.3 Where the addendum type requires a waste DNA sample to be registered, the addendum type's waste DNA registration fee posts with the DNA sample.

## 3. Monthly pet rent

3.1 Pet rent posts on the addendum type's pet rent charge day for each month the pet is approved.

3.2 The month of approval and the month in which the addendum ends are handled by the addendum type's proration setting:

| Proration setting of the addendum type | Month of approval | Month the addendum ends |
|---|---|---|
| Prorated | Prorated pet rent | Prorated pet rent |
| Not prorated | No pet rent (free) | Full monthly pet rent |

3.3 Prorated pet rent is the monthly pet rent multiplied by the days billed and divided by the actual number of days in that month, rounded to the cent. Each pet rent line records the days billed and the days of the month.

3.4 Pet rent may rise, after the addendum type's pet rent hold of months following approval, only with the addendum type's number of calendar days of written notice.

## 4. Move-out flea treatment

4.1 When the addendum of a dog or cat ends at move-out, the move-out flea treatment fee of its addendum type posts, dated the end date.

4.2 A flea treatment fee of 0.00 posts no line.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

- Hypothetical monthly pet rent 50.00, proration applies, 12 days billed in a 30-day month: 50.00 multiplied by 12 and divided by 30 is 20.00.
- Hypothetical monthly pet rent 40.00, proration applies, 10 days billed in a 31-day month: 40.00 multiplied by 10 and divided by 31 is 12.903…, which is 12.90 to the cent.
- Hypothetical addendum type without proration, approved mid-month and ending mid-month in a later month: the approval month carries no pet rent and the end month carries the full monthly pet rent.
- Hypothetical cat addendum ending at move-out, where the addendum type's flea treatment fee is 0.00: no flea treatment line posts.

## Points of judgement

- **Can pet rent post on a registration still pending approval?** No. Rule 1.1 allows pet charges only while the addendum is active or ended.
- **After an addendum has ended, can pet rent for a day after the end date post?** No. Rule 1.2 allows, once ended, only the move-out flea treatment and charges for days before the end date.
- **Is the one-time pet fee returned when the addendum ends?** No. Rule 2.1: it is never refundable.
